full_judgment: 4. Mr. Nawab Ali contends that for the same offence the petitioner has been penalised twice which is not permissible in law. He also contends that the impugned order ex facie was malafide as the petitioner was deprived of the opportunity to show cause against the proposed action passed for dismissal from service. Be that as it may, the order impugned has been passed under Martial Law Order 9 of 1982 against which a review petition was duly filed and as the same has not yet been disposed of we are not inclined to enter into the merit and decide the case on merit.
